insurer: Zurich Kotak General Insurance Company (India) Limited

room_rent.display: As per Policy Schedule (optional cap available)
room_rent.note: Room rent limit is specified in the Policy Schedule. An optional 'Cap on Room Rent' cover is available for a premium discount; if cap is not opted, full room rent is payable subject to SI. Proportionate deduction applies if room exceeds eligible limit when cap is opted.

icu.display: No cap (proportionate deduction not applied to ICU)
icu.note: Policy explicitly states proportionate deductions will not be applied in respect of ICU Charges.

copayment.display: None (zone-based co-pay if treated in higher zone)
copayment.note: No co-pay for treatment within eligible zone. Zone II insured treated in Zone I: 10%; Zone III in Zone I: 20%; Zone III in Zone II: 10%. No co-pay for accident hospitalisation outside zone.

sub_limits.display: Cataract capped at 10% of SI, max ₹1L/eye/year
sub_limits.note: Cataract: 10% of Base Sum Insured up to ₹1,00,000 per eye per Policy Year. No other disease-wise sub-limits explicitly stated in wording.

deductible.note: No aggregate deductible mentioned in the policy wording.

initial_waiting.note: 30-day waiting period for illnesses from first policy commencement date; accidents exempt.

ped_waiting.display: 36 months (or 24 months as per Policy Schedule)
ped_waiting.note: Policy states 36/24 months as mentioned in the Policy Schedule. Base/default is 36 months; 24 months may be available depending on plan opted.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Listed conditions include cataract, hernia, hydrocele, BPH, joint replacements, stones, varicose veins, etc.

maternity.display: Covered (36mo wait, sub-limit applies, max 2 deliveries)
maternity.note: Maternity Benefit (Section 2.19) covers delivery including C-section and lawful MTP. 36-month waiting period. Sub-limit as per Policy Schedule. Max 2 deliveries across all policy periods. Includes pre/post natal expenses, newborn cover and vaccination expenses as a package.

cumulative_bonus.display: 10% per year, max as per Policy Schedule
cumulative_bonus.note: 10% of Base SI added per claim-free year. Maximum cap specified in Policy Schedule (not stated in wording). CB not applicable on Maternity, Newborn, Vaccination, Critical Illness or PA covers.

restoration.display: Once/year, 100% of Base SI (unrelated illness only)
restoration.note: Restored SI cannot be used for same illness/complication already claimed in that year. Does not apply to first claim unless accidental injury exceeds Base SI. No CB on restored SI.

pre_hosp.note: Number of days specified in Policy Schedule; wording does not state a fixed number.

post_hosp.note: Number of days specified in Policy Schedule; wording does not state a fixed number.

day_care.display: Listed procedures only (400+ procedures in Annexure II)
day_care.note: Only Day Care Treatments listed in Annexure II are covered. Extensive list covering ENT, ophthalmology, oncology, urology, orthopaedics, gynaecology, etc.

domiciliary.note: Covered up to Base SI. Excluded conditions include asthma, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy, psychiatric disorders, arthritis, tonsillitis, etc.

ayush.note: Inpatient or Day Care AYUSH treatment at recognised AYUSH Hospital covered up to Base Sum Insured.

organ_donor.note: Harvesting expenses for organ donor covered up to Base SI. Pre/post hospitalisation and organ acquisition costs excluded.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to limit in Policy Schedule for emergency hospitalisation and inter-hospital transfers. Air ambulance also available (within Base SI) as a separate benefit (Section 2.22).

modern_treatments.note: Policy wording does not explicitly mention modern/robotic/advanced treatments as a named benefit or exclusion beyond standard IRDAI exclusions.

consumables.display: Not covered (non-medical items excluded per Annexure III)
consumables.note: Annexure III lists non-payable items. Sterilised gloves payable; unsterilised not. No consumables rider mentioned.

global_cover.display: Not covered (India only, except CI & PA covers)
global_cover.note: Policy states no claims payable unless cause of action arises in India. Critical Illness Cover and Personal Accident Cover are explicitly worldwide.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage, no claim/policy contestable except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: 30 days grace period for annual/quarterly/half-yearly premium. 15 days for monthly instalment premium.

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only, not on renewals or portability.

portability.note: Portability as per IRDAI guidelines; apply at least 30 days before renewal.

notable_exclusions.display: OPD treatment, treatment outside India, external congenital anomalies, sleep disorders, ECP/EECP/hyperbaric oxygen (unless inpatient), spinal manipulation therapy

optional_riders.display: Critical Illness Cover (18 CIs), Personal Accident Cover (death & PTD), Maternity+Newborn+Vaccination package, Cap on Room Rent (premium discount), Hospital Daily Cash, Air Ambulance
